tbesh_html:
1) to be satiated or saturated, have or drink one's fill
1a) (Qal) to take one's fill
1b) (Piel)
1b1) to be drunk, be intoxicated
1b2) to drench, water abundantly, saturate
1c) (Hiphil) to saturate, water, cause to drink

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to slake the thirst (occasionally of other appetites)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: bathe, make drunk, (take the) fill, satiate, (abundantly) satisfy, soak, water (abundantly).
